# Console logo artwork

Source: [RetroPie/es-theme-carbon](https://github.com/RetroPie/es-theme-carbon), commit `b09973e0b0c589cb11fe772c169a6ff5d588b390`.

Carbon theme by Rookervik, based on the Simple theme by Nils Bonenberger. The original `system.svg` files are retained here without changes. Logos and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.

The upstream README describes the artwork as CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0 and includes a 4.0 license text. Its complete attribution, logo notice and license text are retained verbatim in [UPSTREAM-README.txt](UPSTREAM-README.txt). These separately licensed artwork files are not covered by EmuVora's MIT license.

Adaptations: EmuVora renders the SVG artwork to transparent 400 x 96 PNGs, trims transparent margins and scales proportionally. Missing editor namespace declarations are supplied only in temporary rendering copies. The derived PNGs in `src/EmuVora.App/Assets/ConsoleLogos` retain the upstream noncommercial/share-alike artwork terms. No upstream fonts, sounds or other theme files are bundled.

The Neo Geo logo is shared by Neo Geo and Neo Geo CD, with a separate CD marker in the interface. FinalBurn Neo uses the generic Arcade logo and a separate FBNeo marker. Unrecognized library systems use a generic device symbol with an accessible name and tooltip.
